integrity: All statements have analytic proofs; finite numerical tests are corroborative, not proofs.
scientific_limitations: Cross-family identity is at one spectral sector; sharp negative-type equivalence is proved only at k=3. Independent validation has not been performed. Earlier distance-regular association scheme literature may contain equivalent relationships.
title: A radial spectral bridge between odd graphs and folded cubes, with a shared sharp negative-type exponent
